verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox has no first-party natural-language interface. It is agent-ready rather than NL-operable. The `sandbox` CLI is documented for agentic workflows, docs are available as llms.txt and markdown, an OpenAPI spec exists, and the default image ships with coding agents, so an external AI agent can drive it from natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface or built-in assistant, an official MCP server or agent integration for operating sandboxes, and any hands-on evidence of NL-driven operation.
